_metadata.rule: Every item below must be SATISFIED, each with a resolvable written evidence reference, before _metadata.may_publish may leave false or release_status/publication_status may leave candidate_unapproved. tools/validate_facilities_candidate.py refuses a candidate that claims otherwise while any item is missing. Nothing in this repository can satisfy an item: the evidence comes from the source owner, Legal or the engineering lead, and is recorded here by reference.

items.evidence_required: A document or correspondence naming the organisation that produced and published the dataset, with an authoritative contact.
items.why: The file names no organisation anywhere in its 90 columns; the brief's name for it (NHF) is not in the data.

items.requirement: Licence or written permission to use the data
items.evidence_required: A licence text, or a written grant from the owner, covering WellaPath's use of this snapshot.
items.why: Nothing accompanied the data. Without this, no downstream question about redistribution or app use can even be asked.

items.evidence_required: The licence or grant states, or the owner confirms in writing, that a derived artifact (normalised, deduplicated, coordinate-corrected) may be redistributed.
items.why: The candidate is a modified derivative: fields are dropped, values normalised, 11,000+ coordinate pairs exchanged under a recorded rule.

items.evidence_required: Written confirmation that the data may be served to the public through a mobile application, including offline caching on the device.
items.why: The artifact is downloaded to and held on users' phones; some licences permit internal use only.

items.evidence_required: The exact attribution text the owner requires, or written confirmation that none is required.
items.why: Attribution, if required, must appear in the artifact metadata and in the app before first publication; it cannot be added to an immutable published version afterwards.

items.evidence_required: The owner's declared version or export date for this snapshot.
items.why: The file declares none. The candidate carries only an inferred bound (newest record updated_at 2026-07-21T13:15:26, zone undeclared).

items.evidence_required: Definitions for every column used, at minimum facility_type_id, facility_level_option_id, facility_level_options_category_id, operational_hours, the service Yes/No columns, and the meaning of the verified/validated/published workflow fields.
items.why: Three id columns have no name column and no dictionary; the meaning of 'Auto-approved via bulk import' on every row is undocumented; lga_id turned out to be name-scoped.

items.requirement: Contact or document establishing authority to grant the above
items.evidence_required: Evidence that the person or office giving AUTH-02 to AUTH-05 is entitled to speak for the owner.
items.why: A permission from someone without authority is not a permission.

items.requirement: Chain of custody for the supplied copy
items.evidence_required: Confirmation of how the file travelled from the owner to this repository, or a fresh export obtained directly from the owner.
items.why: The supplied copy passed through Apple Numbers (macOS WhereFroms attribute) and is not a pristine upstream export; the coordinate transposition may have been introduced or preserved anywhere along that path.
